lessons.title: Getting Started with Go
lessons.description: Install Go, set up GOPATH, understand workspaces, write Hello World, and explore the Go toolchain.

lessons.title: Variables, Constants, and Basic Types
lessons.description: Variable declarations, zero values, constants, iota, basic types, and type conversions.

lessons.title: Control Flow: if, for, switch
lessons.description: For loops, if with statement, switch expressions, type switches, and defer/panic/recover.

lessons.title: Functions and Multiple Return Values
lessons.description: Function declarations, multiple return values, named returns, variadic functions, closures, and function values.

lessons.title: Arrays, Slices, and Range
lessons.description: Array declarations, slice mechanics (make, append, copy), slice internals, and the range keyword.

lessons.title: Maps and Structs
lessons.description: Map creation and operations, structs, struct embedding, tags, and JSON serialization.

lessons.title: Methods and Interfaces
lessons.description: Method declarations, pointer vs value receivers, interface types, interface satisfaction, and the empty interface.

lessons.title: Pointers and Memory
lessons.description: Pointer types, new function, stack vs heap, escape analysis, and unsafe pointer operations.

lessons.title: Errors, Panic, and Recover
lessons.description: The error interface, custom errors, error wrapping, panic/recover, and error handling patterns.

lessons.title: Packages and Modules
lessons.description: Package declarations, import paths, go modules, versioning, and publishing packages.

lessons.title: Goroutines and Channels
lessons.description: Launch goroutines with go keyword, create and use channels for communication, use select for multiplexing, understand goroutine scheduling and leaks.

lessons.title: sync Package: Mutex, WaitGroup, Once, Pool
lessons.description: Use sync.Mutex and RWMutex for thread safety, sync.WaitGroup for goroutine coordination, sync.Once for one-time initialization, sync.Pool for object reuse.

lessons.title: Context: Cancellation and Timeouts
lessons.description: Create contexts with Background, TODO, WithCancel, implement timeouts and deadlines with WithTimeout, pass request-scoped values through context.

lessons.title: Testing: testing Package and Table-Driven Tests
lessons.description: Write unit tests with testing.T, use table-driven tests, write benchmarks with testing.B, use go test flags and coverage.

lessons.title: I/O: Readers, Writers, and File Operations
lessons.description: Use io.Reader and io.Writer interfaces, work with files via os package, use bufio for buffered I/O, use io.Copy, io.MultiReader, io.TeeReader.

lessons.title: JSON, Encoding, and Serialization
lessons.description: Marshal and unmarshal JSON with encoding/json, use struct tags for JSON field mapping, write custom JSON marshalers/unmarshalers.

lessons.title: HTTP Server, Client, and Middleware
lessons.description: Build HTTP servers with net/http, handle requests with ServeMux routers, make HTTP requests with http.Client, write middleware pattern.

lessons.title: Reflection and Generics (Go 1.18+)
lessons.description: Use reflect package for runtime type inspection, write generic functions with type parameters, use constraints for type bounds.

lessons.title: Modules, Packages, and Dependency Management
lessons.description: Create and publish Go modules, manage versions with go mod and semantic versioning, use workspaces for multi-module projects.

lessons.title: Building CLI Tools with flag and cobra
lessons.description: Use flag package for command-line flags, use cobra for complex CLI applications, handle os.Args and subcommands.

lessons.title: Low-Level Programming, unsafe, and CGo
lessons.description: Use the unsafe package for low-level memory manipulation, call C code with cgo, understand Go's memory model and GC.
